description: The client opens a channel for a client-paid challenge: the payer pays fees and rent and signs, the delegated session key is authorizedSigner, openSlot is the challenged recentSlot, the blockhash is the challenged one and channelId is the PDA of those seeds (salt 7, the vector's).

spec.quote: Clients SHOULD set openSlot to the challenge's methodDetails.recentSlot and MUST use the challenged recentBlockhash in the transaction.

description: feePayer: the client builds with feePayerKey as fee payer and rentPayer and leaves that slot empty for the server.

spec.quote: The client builds the open transaction with the server's feePayerKey as fee payer, partially signs (deposit transfer authority only), and sends via transaction in the open credential.

description: The challenge proposes a co-recipient split; the client commits exactly that preimage.

spec.quote: | distributionSplits | array | OPTIONAL | Splits preimage (see the challenge's methodDetails.distributionSplits); MUST byte-match the splits proposed in the 402 challenge |

description: A Token-2022 mint with tokenProgram Token-2022: the escrow and payer token accounts are Token-2022 ATAs.

spec.quote: MUST be either the SPL Token Program or the Token-2022 Program when present.

description: The client's voucher key is the payer itself.

spec.quote: | authorizedSigner | string | REQUIRED | Base58 public key bound into the PDA seeds as the voucher signer; MAY equal payer or a delegated signer |

description: A new-channel challenge without recentBlockhash: the client has no blockhash it may use. Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/recentBlockhash removed.

spec.quote: The server MUST obtain it from the selected network, and the client MUST use it as the transaction message's recent blockhash.

description: A new-channel challenge without recentSlot. Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/recentSlot removed.

spec.quote: Conditionally REQUIRED when channelId is absent and MUST be absent when resuming an existing channel.

description: feePayer true without feePayerKey. Pair: session-build-open-sponsored. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/feePayer set to true.

spec.quote: When true, feePayerKey MUST also be present.

description: channelProgram is an unknown program. Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/channelProgram set to "Stake11111111111111111111111111111111111111".

spec.quote: Clients MUST verify the methodDetails.channelProgram in the challenge matches a known, audited program before depositing funds.

description: currency "sol". Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /currency set to "sol".

spec.quote: Native SOL is not supported; clients wishing to pay in SOL MUST wrap it to wSOL (So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112) before opening a channel.

description: tokenProgram is the System Program. Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/tokenProgram set to "11111111111111111111111111111111".

spec.quote: MUST be either the SPL Token Program or the Token-2022 Program when present.

description: network "testnet". Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/network set to "testnet".
gracePeriodSeconds 0. Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/gracePeriodSeconds set to 0.

spec.quote: The value MUST be greater than zero.

description: voucherSigner operator with no operator key. Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/voucherSigner set to "operator".

spec.quote: Conditionally REQUIRED when voucherSigner is operator.

description: The challenge omits decimals for its mint. Pair: session-build-open-client-paid. Challenge edit: challenge /methodDetails/decimals removed.

spec.quote: MUST be present when currency is a mint address.
